heroDescription: What started as showing friends around Chow Kit market has become 14 years of sharing the real Malaysia, one meal at a time.

founderSection.heading: She Started by Taking Friends to the Market
paragraphs: Growing up in Malaysia, I spent my mornings walking through wet markets with my mom. While she haggled for the freshest fish, I watched the hawkers craft dishes that had been passed down for generations. The sizzle of char kway teow on a screaming hot wok. The aromatic clouds of curry. The careful art of folding roti canai. This was my Malaysia.

When I started bringing friends from overseas around, I realised they were missing all of it. They'd eat at air-conditioned restaurants with picture menus, never knowing that two streets away, a grandmother was making laksa the same way her mother taught her 60 years ago.

Simply Enak started in 2011 because I wanted to share what I grew up with. Not the Malaysia in guidebooks, the one I know. The night markets. The family recipes. The vendors who remember your face and your favourite dish. The real Malaysia that tourists walk past every day.

timelineSection.heading: 14 Years of Simply Enak
timelineSection.description: From a first food walk through Chow Kit to features in National Geographic, BBC, and Lonely Planet. A few things happened along the way.

milestones.title: 5,000+ guests and still eating
milestones.description: Every week, travellers from around the world join us at the same stalls we've eaten at for 14 years. The guides know the vendors by name. The vendors know us.

milestones.title: BBC World Service
milestones.description: Simply Enak is featured on the BBC World Service, sharing the story of Malaysian street food culture with a global audience.

milestones.title: National Geographic
milestones.description: National Geographic features Simply Enak in their coverage of Kuala Lumpur's best authentic food experiences, highlighting our focus on family-run stalls and local culture.

milestones.title: Lonely Planet
milestones.description: Lonely Planet recommends Simply Enak as a top food tour in Kuala Lumpur, recognising our guides' deep knowledge of KL's street food heritage.

milestones.title: The Food Ranger
milestones.description: Trevor James (The Food Ranger) joins a Simply Enak tour, bringing Malaysian street food to millions of YouTube viewers worldwide.

milestones.title: Simply Enak Founded
milestones.description: Pauline leads her first food walk through Chow Kit market with a small group of friends. Nobody calls it a tour yet.

philosophySection.heading: Three Things We Won't Compromise On

items.title: No Scripts
items.description: Our guides are licensed professionals, but they talk to you like friends. Real stories, not rehearsed speeches. You'll get a different tour every time because you're different every time.

items.title: Slow Down
items.description: We walk. We pause. We take the time to notice things: the architecture, the smells, the sounds of the neighbourhood. A food tour shouldn't feel like a marathon.

items.title: Support Local
items.description: We focus on small, local vendors — many family-run for generations. Your tour fee goes to the heritage keepers of Malaysian food culture — the same people who've been feeding this neighbourhood for decades.

teamSection.heading: The People Behind the Flavours
teamSection.description: We're a small team, all licensed with Tourism Malaysia. More importantly, we grew up eating at these same stalls. We know the vendors by name, the neighbourhoods by heart, and the stories behind every dish.
